name: Костёр — иконка
subject: ONE compact fantasy BUILD MENU icon showing ONLY the building from second reference image, three-quarter composition, retain its wood/steel/brass materials and characteristic silhouette. SECOND image defines structure, NOT voxel rendering: convert to crisp rich 2D PIXEL ILLUSTRATION like first image. No construction arrows, ground, NPC, tool overlay, text or surrounding scene. ONE fantasy CAMPFIRE hearth: ring of EIGHT thick cubical warm-gray stones, four chunky crossed dark-oak logs within ring, dark charcoal ember bed and large Minecraft-stepped amber flame with pale cream centre and orange-red lower tongues. Broad readable cubes, flat colors; flame does NOT cast light or shadow onto backdrop. Hearth stones and fuel are asset itself, no dirt, terrain platform, smoke cloud or additional scenery.
caption: Пиксельная иконка меню строительства, согласованная с пятиракурсным референсом этой постройки.
